steps.name: Given the company actor is signed in and active
And the influencer actor is signed in and active
And the admin is signed in with a mock session
And the admin enables all notification preferences for the company
When the company checks unread notification count
Then the unread count is stored as "initialCount"
When the company creates partnership opportunity "NotifCampaign":
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"id":2501,"name":"Notification Test Campaign","city":"Warszawa","title":"E2E Notification Testing","details":"Testing notifications with email delivery","requirements":"Any influencer","followersMin":1,"followersMax":1000000,"compensationType":{"value":"CASH","label":"Gotówka","originalLabel":"CASH"},"compensationAmountMin":100,"compensationAmountMax":500,"currency":{"id":1,"name":"Euro","origina
And the GreenMail inbox is cleared
When the influencer applies to opportunity "NotifCampaign" with note "Testing notification delivery!" storing the application as "notifApp"
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"id":2501,"opportunityStatus":{"value":"APPLIED","label":"Zgłoszona","description":"Influencer zgłosił się do kampanii i czeka na odpowiedź firmy","originalLabel":"APPLIED","colorTheme":"primary","icon":"user","aliases":["waiting"],"possibleTransitions":["ACCEPTED_BY_COMPANY","REJECTED_BY_COMPANY"],"terminal":false,"successful":false},"rateStatus":{"value":"DEFAULT","label":"Domyślna","originalLa
When the company checks unread notification count
Then the unread count should be greater than "initialCount"
When the company fetches notifications page 0 size 10
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"content":[{"id":84,"type":"APPLICATION_RECEIVED","category":"PARTNERSHIP","priority":"HIGH","colorTheme":"amber","icon":"heroicons_outline:exclamation-circle","title":"New Application Received","message":"influencer1 has applied to your opportunity: E2E Notification Testing","actionUrl":"/collaborations/registrations","actionLabel":"Review Application","isRead":false,"snapshot":{"influencer":{"i
And the notifications response should contain at least 1 notification
And the first notification should have type "APPLICATION_RECEIVED"
notifications page must not be empty
And the first notification id is stored as "notifId"
first notification must carry an id
When the email queue is processed
Then GreenMail should have received at least 1 email
And the last GreenMail email should contain subject "[CheckItOut]"
GreenMail inbox must not be empty
When the company marks notification "notifId" as read
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"id":84,"type":"APPLICATION_RECEIVED","category":"PARTNERSHIP","priority":"HIGH","colorTheme":"amber","icon":"heroicons_outline:exclamation-circle","title":"New Application Received","message":"influencer1 has applied to your opportunity: E2E Notification Testing","actionUrl":"/collaborations/registrations","actionLabel":"Review Application","isRead":true,"readAt":"2026-10-18T07:05:53.208265276",
And the notification response should have isRead true
no notification captured from the mark-as-read call
When the company marks all notifications as read
Then the response status should be 200
When the company checks unread notification count
Then the unread count should be 0
When the company fetches notifications page 0 size 10
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"content":[{"id":84,"type":"APPLICATION_RECEIVED","category":"PARTNERSHIP","priority":"HIGH","colorTheme":"amber","icon":"heroicons_outline:exclamation-circle","title":"New Application Received","message":"influencer1 has applied to your opportunity: E2E Notification Testing","actionUrl":"/collaborations/registrations","actionLabel":"Review Application","isRead":true,"readAt":"2026-10-18T07:05:53
And the notifications response should contain at least 1 notification
Then the response status should be 204
When the company fetches notifications page 0 size 10
Then the response status should be 200
And the notifications response should not contain notification "notifId"
When the influencer fetches notifications page 0 size 10
Then the response status should be 200
And the notifications response should not contain notification "notifId"
